articles.title: The Writer Who Invented Cyberpunk Has Never Played a Video Game
articles.summary: Cyberpunk pioneer William Gibson says he has never played a video game, yet viral clips of Grand Theft Auto VI have him intrigued.

articles.title: A Lost Video Game From 1977 Is Playable Again
articles.summary: Magic Caves, a 1977 text adventure by physicist John Trenholme, was lost for decades and is now playable again.

articles.title: What Would Sports Look Like With No Gravity?
articles.summary: A former NASA chief technologist explains why sports in zero gravity would break every rule we know: no arcs, no up or down, and Newton wins every time.
